content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, Filipino digital creators can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This stack can be set up using free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. With this infrastructure in place, creators can start selling their digital products to international buyers without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack for Filipino digital creators includes a hosting platform, a backend logic tool, and a payment processing system. USDT on Tron is a viable option for payment processing, as it settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This stack can be deployed quickly and easily, allowing creators to start selling their products and receiving payments in cryptocurrency.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Filipino digital creators can skip the steps that do not matter yet, such as setting up a complex e-commerce platform or integrating multiple payment gateways. Instead, they can focus on deploying a simple and functional digital commerce stack that allows them to start selling their products and receiving payments. This approach enables creators to get to market quickly and start generating revenue, without getting bogged down in unnecessary complexity.
Deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack to start selling digital products internationally.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get their first transaction live, Filipino digital creators need to set up a payment processing system and integrate it with their digital commerce stack. NOWPayments is a suitable option, as it supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a 0.5% fee. Creators can also use Binance P2P, which supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, among other currencies. With these payment options in place, creators can start receiving payments from international buyers and growing their businesses.
